numericValidation.policy: each bound must be a finite, nonnegative INTEGER and at or below the product ceiling; a violation is REFUSED with CAPSULE_LIMIT_INVALID naming the key
accepted: a finite nonnegative integer at or below the ceiling
numericValidation.baselineDefect: P2-D1 used Math.max(0, Math.min(value, ceiling)); Math.min(NaN, x) is NaN and every `bytes > NaN` comparison is false, so a NaN budget silently DISABLED the whole-byte bound (F7)

legacyMaxTotalChars.meaning: the SUM of the INCLUDED event-summary character lengths
legacyMaxTotalChars.behavior: an event whose clamped summary would breach the aggregate budget is OMITTED rather than admitted
legacyMaxTotalChars.baselineDefect: P2-D1 declared the bound and never summed against it (F8)

truncation.baselineDefect: P2-D1 reported `truncated: omitted > 0` and mentioned only omitted events, so a summary-only shortening read as untruncated and a PARTIAL source was not separated (F10)

wholeByteCeiling: TRAJECTORY_CAPSULE_HARD_MAX_SERIALIZED_BYTES = 16384, enforced on the UTF-8 JSON encoding; a caller may lower, never raise
expectedInvariant: no runtime input can disable or widen a declared Capsule bound, and no truncation kind is disguised as another
remainingUncertainty: the essential-metadata floor can still exceed a very small budget, in which case the build refuses with CAPSULE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED rather than dropping required provenance
